name: Lichterfest am Achensee
beschreibung: The Festival of Lights at Lake Achensee transforms the lakeside promenade into a shimmering sea of thousands of candles and lanterns. Live music, fire shows, and a spectacular fireworks display over the lake form the highlight of the evening. A romantic summer event for all ages.
kurzbeschreibung: Thousands of lights, fire shows, and spectacular fireworks on the shores of Lake Achensee.
